name: Zephyr SDK
description: Downloads and installs one or more Zephyr SDK releases (toolchains for Zephyr RTOS). Optionally installs west and the Zephyr build-host apt prerequisites (cmake, ninja-build, gperf, device-tree-compiler, ccache). Supports installing multiple SDK versions side-by-side so a single container can build several Zephyr projects whose pinned SDK_VERSION differs. Pairs well with the kas + yocto-host features when a single container builds both a Yocto host image and Zephyr firmware.

version.description: Primary Zephyr SDK version to install from github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/sdk-ng. ZEPHYR_SDK_INSTALL_DIR (via the /opt/zephyr-sdk symlink) points at this one. As of May 2026 the latest releases are 1.0.1 (matches Zephyr 4.x, the current stable line) and 0.17.4 (latest 0.17.x, required by Zephyr 3.7 LTS and earlier). Pin to match your firmware's tested SDK.

extra_versions.description: Optional comma-separated list of additional SDK versions to install alongside `version`, e.g. "0.17.4,0.16.8". Each lands at /opt/zephyr-sdk-X.Y.Z/. Zephyr CMake's find_zephyr_sdk() scans that path and picks the highest version satisfying each project's zephyr/SDK_VERSION minimum — unset ZEPHYR_SDK_INSTALL_DIR in a per-build shell to enable that auto-pick (otherwise the primary `version` wins). Leave empty for the single-SDK case.

install_dir.description: Parent directory the SDKs are unpacked into. Each lands at ${install_dir}/zephyr-sdk-${version}. A stable ${install_dir}/zephyr-sdk symlink is created pointing at the primary version; ZEPHYR_SDK_INSTALL_DIR (containerEnv) refers to that symlink.

toolchains.description: Which toolchains to keep installed (applied to every SDK in `version` + `extra_versions`). 'all' downloads the full SDK bundle (~2 GB per version on disk); 'minimal' downloads the small bundle and lets the user add toolchains later; a specific triple installs only that toolchain. For Cortex-M / Cortex-A53 work pick 'arm-zephyr-eabi' or 'aarch64-zephyr-elf'.

host_deps.description: Install the Zephyr build-host apt prerequisites alongside the SDK toolchain: cmake, ninja-build, gperf, device-tree-compiler, ccache, build-essential. These are NOT part of the SDK bundle itself but are required for `west build` to succeed. Installed at image-build time so they cache in the feature's Docker layer (no per-rebuild re-download). Disable only if a downstream feature already provides this set (e.g., a fuller Yocto host image).

install_west.description: Pip-install west alongside the SDK. Most Zephyr workflows need it. Disable if your project ships its own pinned west via a Python venv inside the workspace.
